newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens bourse cancels Monday's trading session.
newsitem.headline: Athens bourse cancels Monday's trading session.

text.p: The Athens stock exchange called off Monday's trading session due to persisting technical problems, bourse supervisor Panayiotis Panayiotopoulos told Reuters.
"The electronic trading system overloaded today forcing the bourse to cancel all trades," said Panayiotopoulos.
Asked if the overloading was attributed to high volume in private Xiosbank which made its trading debut on Monday, he said: "This could well be the case."
The Athens bourse issued a statement saying it would cancel today's session to prevent questions of validity of trades from being raised.
